caption:
Waterproof PP shuttering sheet se barish aur keechad mein bhi site ka kaam chalu rakhiye.

Paani lagne par yeh sheet bilkul nahi phoolti aur nails bhi mazbooti se hold karti hai.
Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur har dhalai ka kharcha kam karti hai.
